Name: Adjustable Joja Prices
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
Lets you adjust the price of joja membership/community developments/theatre by the [font=Courier New]AdjustmentFactor [/font][font=Arial]config entry.[/font]

Default value is 0.7 - which is 70% of the standard price. Supports GMCM, in the UI you can set it from 0.01 (1%) to 10 (10000% i think) (although, if you change it you'll have to restart the game for at least the theatre price to take effect)

Yes I know Morris says "half a mil" when buying the theatre.

Yes I know [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52736]ASLaneZero's[/url] exists. We both got the idea from the [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1494]same mod ideas issue [/url]and I was already done mine byt the time I saw it got released

source: https://git.pillow.rocks/pillow/AdjustableJojaPrices
